pages.raw_meta: Discover Pitney Bowes, a global leader in technology-driven solutions for shipping, mailing, and financial services. Serving businesses of all sizes, we simplify the complexities of sending mail and parcels with innovative software and services that enhance efficiency and drive business growth.
raw_blocks: The technology behind every important delivery.

For more than a century, Pitney Bowes has been part of how the world moves. Our connected enterprise provides digital shipping solutions, mailing innovation and presort services to businesses and governments around the world, including 90 percent of the Fortune 500.
Our values - The Pitney Bowes way.
Decide with the information you have.
Simplify. Eliminate what isn't working.
Adapt. Execute with discipline and urgency.
Align on our shared vision and purpose.
Bring your perspective, respect theirs.
Help others grow and thrive.
Define great and achieve it.
Deliver exceptional outcomes for clients.

"Pitney Bowes was built not on a single product or moment, but on a sustained commitment to helping the world move. That commitment gave us something rare: a century of evolution and experience, deeply rooted client relationships, and leading capabilities in data, AI, and embedded finance. Our next chapter will be built on all of it, by people who move fast, deliver excellence, and win together."
Kurt Wolf Chief Executive Officer
Our time. Our Pitney Bowes.

Our heritage is also our proof. We are not built on a single product or moment, but on a sustained commitment to making shipping and mail work for the business and people who depend on it. That foundation is what makes our next chapter possible. Discover 100+ years of innovation.

Pitney Bowes is headquartered in Shelton, Connecticut with offices across the globe. We also have a national network strategically located throughout the United States to serve our clients' shipping and mailing needs.

Learn how businesses across industries, including higher education, healthcare, and manufacturing, have transformed their operations with Pitney Bowes' tailored technologies and services.
raw_blocks: Simplifying business. Customer success delivered.

See how businesses across industries streamline operations, reduce complexity and achieve measurable success with Pitney Bowes. From small businesses to large enterprises and agencies, our mailing, shipping and financing solutions help teams work smarter, move faster and operate more securely.
Aprio centralized shipping and mailing across 40 offices with Pitney Bowes Shipping 360®, saving over $164K/year and boosting efficiency ~40%.
Fairfield University transformed campus mail delivery with Pitney Bowes smart lockers, giving students 24/7 access, real-time alerts and improved efficiency while reducing staff workload.
This Fortune 50 healthcare enterprise serves millions of members through a network of health plans, physician groups, pharmacies, care centers and healthcare service organizations.
“This was the smoothest software installation in the bank’s history.”
Vice President of Operations, Financial Institution

The Missouri Department of Social Services is one of the state’s largest public service organizations, supporting residents through programs focused on family services, healthcare assistance, financial support and community well-being.
Discover how TitleOne boosted mailing accuracy and efficiency with Pitney Bowes, cutting costs, tracking shipments and streamlining operations.
Pitney Bowes helped a U.S. financial enterprise standardize shipping for 200,000 users across 5,500 locations, cutting costs, improving security and eliminating postage meters.

Mars Capital partnered with Pitney Bowes to automate its mailing process, improving security, compliance and scalability. This shift reduced costs and allowed staff to focus on core business activities.
The Texas Tax Assessor-Collector Office optimized mailing and shipping with Pitney Bowes solutions, improving efficiency and service delivery.

“We work with Pitney Bowes to devise rules so we can take the thinking out of our employees’ hands and put it into the application. It helps us get medication to our customers faster and save on shipping costs.”
Senior Manager of Shipping & Logistics, Boston Medical Center
This Fortune 50 healthcare enterprise serves millions of members through a network of health plans, physician groups, pharmacies, care centers, and healthcare service organizations.

Boston Medical Center unified five carriers across seven pharmacy locations to automate prescription shipping, saving $10 million and ~23,000 staff hours a year. See how smarter rules-based shipping improved compliance, cost control, and patient delivery.
Centerstone partnered with Pitney Bowes to automate billing, achieving a 2–3x increase in collections, lower costs, and more time for patient-focused services.

“We really appreciate the intentional steps that Pitney Bowes has taken, how they understand just how students are changing, how our outgoing is changing and how people are shipping, it has really helped us be flexible with what we need.”
Grace McCoy Director of Auxiliary Finances and Lean Officer, Coastal Carolina University
Fairfield University transformed campus mail delivery with Pitney Bowes smart lockers, giving students 24/7 access, real-time alerts, and improved efficiency while reducing staff workload.

The University of Hartford partnered with Pitney Bowes to modernize its mail center, introducing automated tracking, barcode scanning, and streamlined pickup. The result: reduced delays, better organization, and a smoother experience for students and staff.
Coastal Carolina's growing student population caused mailroom bottlenecks, with old systems struggling to process mail and handle student and faculty packages.
